rows.note: This is the all-purpose term in Cantonese grammar for a word that identifies or distinguishes a noun referent.

example.english: A determiner can help us identify the referent of a noun.
example.traditional: 限定詞可以幫我哋界定名詞所指嘅對象。
example.jyutping: haan6 ding6 ci4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 gaai3 ding6 ming4 ci4 so2 zi2 ge3 deoi3 zoeng6
